note: Explicit candidate protocol suite consumed by the Go E2E lanes. This is candidate input: not a published release, not a release pin and not a conformance claim. The released suite pin is RELEASED_SUITE_PIN in .github/workflows/ci.yml and is never changed by this file. Qualifying a new candidate means replacing revision, manifest_sha256, tree_sha256 and protocol_version together, or supplying candidate_ref and candidate_manifest_sha256 to a workflow_dispatch run.
